Kotak Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is a Commodities Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 05 Aug 1994. Jeetu Valechha Sonar is the Current Fund Manager of Kotak Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹5,92,379 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 30 Oct 2026 is ₹24.28.
